newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys one cargo Mar reformate at $27.60/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys one cargo Mar reformate at $27.60/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) purchased just one 250,000 barrel cargo of 95-octane unleaded reformate in its March 1-15 buying tender at $27.60 per barrel cost and-freight (c-and-f) -- its highest award for some years, a company official said on Thursday.
"It is the highest .. we have never paid so high," the official said. "We awarded just one cargo because the number is not good."
A CPC official told Reuters on Wednesday it intended to buy around two cargoes but had received offers ranging $27.50-$28.00.
The tender closed January 28 and was valid until January 30. Deliveries are to Keelung or Taichung.
The official said CPC would emerge after the Chinese New Year in early February with a new tender for more March cargoes.
CPC's last purchase of unleaded reformate was awarded at $27.00 per barrel c-and-f Keelung or Taichung for delivery February 11-28 to a Japanese trader.
